Sample.evidence_source: [page/14/Text/5] To our knowledge, this is the first randomized placebo controlled trial of a computerized intervention developed specifically as an intervention for adolescents with depression. As such, the present study contributes useful information highlighting the potential of this innovative treatment modality in the treatment of adolescents experiencing mild to moderate depression.
